en: A colorized vintage postcard view over a calm river or canal from a shaded riverside spot with a wooden jetty in the foreground. A man in dark clothing and a cap sits on a bench under large overhanging trees on the left. Across the water are moored boats and steamships, quays, and a townscape with low buildings and church spires in the distance. The caption in Swedish is printed along the bottom margin.
